notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); Provider push sends provider events to WEBHOOK (Flask); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) read + write PostgreSQL and start Temporal workflows; INTERACTION (Flask) also long-polls SQS, enqueues SQS tasks and makes API calls to Twilio.
Temporal workflows read + write PostgreSQL and make API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
Background workers long-poll SQS and read + write PostgreSQL, and also enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
